This plot is small, only about 0.84 hectares, and I am intercropping there so the soil gets some help from the legumes mixed in. I save most of my fertilizer money for my main maize fields on the bigger plots, so on this one I rely mostly on manure from my few cattle and chickens. The rains here in Iringa are usually reliable, so I do not need to irrigate, and for this mixed plot I will use seed I saved from last year because improved seed for these crops is hard to find and costly. My wife and our older children will help me with weeding and harvest, but at peak weeding time I will hire a few neighbors for a couple of days.
